assessments.reasoning: Original range [1708,3497), verified SHA-256 97b4cf38b21d924c0545405c201b1d4dd7f30dd61dd27f0c34bc39e941b54e91, contains the exclusion, the competition language and all three scope clauses. The full original supplies the definitions.

challenge.method: Tested broader readings covering mere use or every affiliate product. Read Competition and each of the three following provisions through the start of Fair Use.
challenge.results: The excluded purpose requires providing a competing product. Marketing a practical substitute establishes competition, and differences in interface, platform or price can coexist with competition. Under New Products, a previously noncompeting provider brought into competition by a new software version or another product using the software may continue with versions available under these terms beforehand only. Under Discontinued Products, competition may begin after provision stops unless the licensor includes with the software a plain-text line beginning `Licensor Line of Business:` that mentions that business. Under Sales of Business, when the licensor or an affiliate sells a line developing the software or using it to provide a product, the buyer can also enforce Noncompete for that product.

limitations: The assessment describes the permission boundary under the exact edition and assumes reliance on its permissions. A particular product's competitive status requires additional facts.
reasoning: Shield excludes the purpose of providing a product that competes with the software itself or with a product the licensor or an affiliate provides using the software. “Product” includes goods, services and combinations. The affiliate definition turns on control. The phrase “provides using the software” limits which other products enter the comparison.
